opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with disability
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) and local authority; UK only
opportunities.summary: Grants for capital projects (new build, refurbishment, equipment) to help people with disability live more independently, focusing on training, employment and supported housing.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working in mental health
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) and local authority; UK only
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for charities working in mental health, focusing on training, employment and supported housing, especially for young people transitioning to adult services.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with older people
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) and local authority; UK only
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for organisations providing care for older people, especially those with neurodegenerative conditions or isolation, for new build, refurbishment or equipment.

opportunities.title: Funding for hospices and palliative care organisations
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or hospices operating within the NHS; UK only
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for hospices and palliative care organisations for new build, refurbishment or equipment to improve patient and family care.

opportunities.title: Funding for historic buildings & landscapes
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority; UK only
opportunities.summary: Grants for conservation, restoration, interpretation and education spaces for historic, architectural and cultural sites of national significance.

opportunities.title: Funding for libraries & archives
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority; UK only
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for libraries and archives caring for nationally significant collections, to improve storage facilities, research, education or interpretation spaces.

opportunities.title: Funding for museums & galleries
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority; UK only
opportunities.summary: Grants to improve display and interpretation of nationally significant collections, including refurbishment or creation of new galleries and education spaces.

opportunities.title: Funding for performing arts organisations
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority; UK only
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for performing arts organisations to improve training and education facilities, including building or refurbishment of such facilities.

opportunities.title: Funding for public engagement with science organisations
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent), local authority or university; UK only
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for organisations with scientific or natural history collections to improve public engagement with science through galleries, exhibitions and education spaces.

opportunities.title: Funding for universities and research institutions
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Research‑intensive universities or research institutions; UK only
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for new buildings, refurbishment or major equipment to enable high‑quality research, including public engagement and research libraries.

opportunities.title: Funding for special schools and colleges
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority; UK only
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for special schools and colleges to support new build, refurbishment or equipment that helps pupils develop skills for employment or independent living.

opportunities.title: Funding for secondary schools & sixth form colleges
opportunities.eligibility_summary: State‑funded secondary schools and sixth form colleges; UK only
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for specialist teaching spaces and equipment in subjects such as science, design & technology, art, languages, music and performing arts.
